item.title: Las Vegas police arrest asst. principal on 15 charges, including sexual assault on child
item.description: Detectives with the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department's Sexual Assault Detail arrested Pernell Graham, 42, on Monday, March 23, according to a release from Metro.

item.title: Family sues after deadly AutoZone shooting in Las Vegas; suspect released from prison weeks earlier
item.description: A family is taking legal action following a deadly shooting inside a Las Vegas auto parts store, alleging the business failed to provide adequate security despite known safety risks.

item.title: Henderson, police unions reach deal, again
item.description: The battle between Henderson City Hall and their police unions was supposed to be over, but a closed-door agreement reveals peace was struck once some lawyers were outside the room.

item.title: Vehicle hits pole in southeast Las Vegas valley causing power outage; driver faces charges
item.description: A vehicle hit a pole in the southeast Las Vegas valley Tuesday morning, causing a small power outage, police said. The driver of that vehicle showed signs of impairment and is facing charges.

item.description: Spring has finally arrived, and with it comes the opening of the butterfly habitat at Springs Preserve.

item.title: Las Vegas asst. principal allegedly had sexual relationship with 14-year-old
item.description: The assistant principal of a local charter school allegedly started a relationship with a 14-year-old girl and threatened her so she wouldn't say anything, prosecutors said in court Tuesday morning.

item.description: Hot mid-90s will continue for a few more days before changes start showing up with a significant cooling trend next week.
